items.source: Logs full invocation details on method entry and method exit, including invocation arguments and invocation count. This is only intended for debugging purposes; use SimpleTraceInterceptor or CustomizableTraceInterceptor for pure tracing purposes.
items.translation: 日志记录方法入口和方法退出时的完整调用详情，包括调用参数和调用次数。此功能仅用于调试目的；若仅需进行纯跟踪，请使用 `SimpleTraceInterceptor` 或 `CustomizableTraceInterceptor`。

items.source: Determines whether logging is enabled for the particular MethodInvocation. If not, the method invocation proceeds as normal, otherwise the method invocation is passed to the invokeUnderTrace method for handling.
